figures.caption: Figure 1: Per-subject leave-one-subject-out accuracy on UGRMINDVOICE for the three tasks of increasing linguistic difficulty (stacked top to bottom). Each box shows the distribution over the 14 held-out subjects; dots are individual subjects, the diamond marks the mean, and the dashed line marks chance (1/classes).

Table 2: Main benchmark on UGR-MINDVOICE: foundation models vs. convolutional baselines. Acc = accuracy (%), W-F1 = weighted F1, κ = Cohen’s kappa. Best per column in bold. Chance accuracy is 1/classes (κ = 0).

Table 3: BCIC2020-T3 imagined speech (5 classes), within-subject and leave-one-subject-out (LOSO). Bal.Acc = balanced accuracy (%), W-F1 = weighted F1, κ = Cohen’s kappa; mean±SD over 15 subjects. Chance accuracy = 20% (κ = 0). Best within-subject value per column in bold. Under LOSO no model exceeds chance (all p > 0.18).
